Command.Statement: SELECT {[Measures].[Unit Sales]} ON 0, NON EMPTY CrossJoin([Store].[Store State].Members, [Product].[Product Family].Members) ON 1 FROM (SELECT CrossJoin(Filter([Store].[Store State].Members, ([Store].[Store State].CurrentMember.member_caption>="CA" AND [Store].[Store State].CurrentMember.member_caption<="CA") OR ("OR" < [Store].[Store State].CurrentMember.member_caption AND [Store].[Store State].CurrentMember.member_caption<"Yucatan")), Filter([Product].[Product Family].Members, ([Product].[Product Family].CurrentMember.member_caption<"Food" OR [Product].[Product Family].CurrentMember.member_caption>"Food"))) ON 0 FROM [ZFMSALES])
